raw_site_text: rural households in western Kenya; villages within two hours of Bungoma Town; two main cities in the study area: Bungoma Town and Kakamega Town
justification: Villages were selected no more than two hours from Bungoma Town, with Bungoma Town and Kakamega Town named as the two main cities in the study area.
note: Kakamega inferred from the named second study-area city; sampled village county boundaries not listed. Nairobi etc. are destinations only.
